title: Open Workplace Health Standard (OWHS) v0.2, draft specification
description:
OWHS is an open data standard for UK workplace health, and an open catalogue of the instruments and survey items behind it. Private by design, free to use.

This record is a draft release: the specification is 0.2-draft, the instrument registry dataset is version 0.9.0 and the question bank is version 0.2.0. The specification text, registry text and guidance text are CC BY 4.0; the schemas, code lists, examples, dataset structure and tools are Apache 2.0. Grades in the registry are single-rater. The record is a snapshot of the repository at the release; the live site is https://openworkplacehealth.org/.
